{{Top|leg}}
The '''Januul''' were an [[Alwari]] [[overclan]] of [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. Their traditional enemies were the [[Borokii]]; as of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], they had clashed for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] over which tribe should be senior among the Alwari. They had around a thousand trained warriors. A subclan of the Januul was the [[Hovsgol Januul]].<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>

The Januul were ruled by the [[Januul Council of Elders]].<ref name="AS" />
